main_text.p: exoriri posse. Quod ultimo suscepimus probandum.

In plurimarum febrium intermittentium paroxysmis ita abdomen ut plurimum distenditur ut si quis linteo quodam intermissionis tempore menturam crassitiei corporis ea parte perperit, experiatur ipsum tempore accessionis febrilis octava parte crassiorem evasisse. tumque anxietates, murmura, dolores, ructus, borborygmi, &c. excitantur; quae si non intelligat Le Vasseur experiatur audiat & intelligat hippocratem sect. 4. aph: 73. sect. 5. aph: 64. & sect. vi. aph: 40. & alia : videatque D. Le Vasseur quantum à veritate, auctoritate omniumque experientia, (propriis praejudiciis obcaecatus) aberraverit.

page.notes: Left edge of the scan is cropped; the first letters of several lines are cut off and have been left out (e.g. "exoriri", "pimus", "entium", "lurimum", "uodam", "uram", "eperit" appear with a missing initial). The text was partly reconstructed from the visible fragments. Printed "tempore menturam" and "octava parte crassiorem" are as read; "evasisse" and "praejudiciis" are doubtful where the scan is faint.
